script: Norway is a land of long, crinkly coastlines, thousands of islands, and snow-capped mountains.

visuals: The snow-capped mountains of Norway under an icy winter sky. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Its winters are icy and dark.

visuals: Lush green hills in Norway during a mild summer with wildflowers. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: While summers bring mild sunshine and green hills.

visuals: The stunning Geirangerfjord in Norway with its deep blue water, steep green cliffs, and waterfalls. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: And get this: Norway is home to some of the most magical landscapes on Earth. Ever heard of a fjord? These are deep, narrow sea inlets surrounded by towering cliffs. The Geirangerfjord is so stunning it looks like a scene from a fantasy movie!

script: Speaking of symbols, Norway picked a tough and majestic animal to represent it: the moose!

visuals: A soccer ball on a soccer field. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Add in the bright red fox, and you’ve got quite a forest team.

visuals: A colorful puffin bird with a painted-looking face perched on a rocky cliff edge in Norway. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: But wait, there’s more! Along the coast, look out for the puffin: a bird with a painted-on face and the cutest nest spots in cliffside burrows.

visuals: The modern Oslo skyline in Norway with the Viking Ship Museum and the green Vigeland Park. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: So, where's the capital? Say hello to Oslo! It’s packed with Viking museums and parks where you might just run into… squirrels, no promises though.

visuals: The iconic Bryggen waterfront in Bergen, Norway, with its row of colorful wooden houses and the rain-slicked harbor. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Then there’s Bergen, famous for its rainbow-colored wooden houses and, yep, lots of rain.

visuals: A snowy night in Tromsø, Norway, with the vibrant green and purple aurora borealis (Northern Lights) dancing in the sky. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: And all the way up in Tromsø? It’s known for the northern lights that appear in the winter sky!

visuals: The Bryggen wharf in Bergen in Norway bustling with people and inhabitants. Open space, not closed. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Norwegian is the main language here, but in some areas, Indigenous Sámi speakers keep their traditions alive with their own words and stories. Isn’t that awesome diversity?

visuals: The Vigeland Sculpture Park in Oslo in Norway bustling with people and inhabitants. Open space, not closed. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Around 5.5 million people live in Norway. That is about the same as the population of Minnesota!

visuals: A block of traditional Norwegian brunost (brown cheese) on a slice of fresh bread on a wooden table. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Hungry already? Norwegians love brunost, a sweet brown cheese, melted on toast. Yum!

visuals: Freshly made Norwegian waffles served with red jam and a dollop of sour cream on a festive plate. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: And when they want something sugary, waffles with jam hit the spot.

visuals: A traditional Norwegian holiday dish of ribbe (crispy pork belly) served with sides on a decorated table. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: At Christmas, locals love crispy pork belly called ribbe.

visuals: A bottle of red julebrus (holiday soda) on a festive table in Norway. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: They wash it down with julebrus, a fizzy berry soda made for the holidays!

visuals: Geirangerfjord in Norway bustling with people and inhabitants. Open space, not closed. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: And on May 17, Norway’s National Day turns into a giant party with parades, waffles, and folks wearing bunads, which are beautiful, traditional outfits.

visuals: A soccer ball on a soccer field. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Now picture this: in 1998, tiny Norway beat mighty Brazil 2–1 in a surprising soccer match. What a moment, and they’re still proud of it!

visuals: Norwegian soccer star Erling Haaland celebrating a goal in his national team jersey. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Norwegians also love skiing, and guess who stands out worldwide? Soccer star Erling Haaland is famous for scoring lots of goals.

visuals: Norwegian chess champion Magnus Carlsen sitting at a chess board during an international match. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: And Magnus Carlsen became world chess champion as a teen and remains one of the best today!

visuals: The Midnight Sun in Norway, hovering just above the horizon over a calm sea at midnight. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Want a fun fact? In parts of Norway, the sun never sets for weeks in the summer. It’s called the Midnight Sun, how cool is that?
